title: Microsoft Purview: new Data Security Posture Management experience
summary: Hold: the briefing extends Microsoft Graph permission requirements from SharePoint item-level scanning to Fabric without supporting documentation. It also promises that every configuration step is audited, whereas the cited documentation guarantees auditing of AI agent actions, not every step.
